what: The vocabularies a finding is indexed by, besides its product, area and principle. A finding has one or more problems, one visibility and one recommendation. The gate fails on a value that is not here, and on a value here that no finding uses, so each list grows from evidence.

problems.label: Unexpected movement
problems.what: Part of the interface moves when the reader did not move it

problems.label: Focus hijack
problems.what: Focus or input goes somewhere the reader did not send it

problems.label: Lost screen space
problems.what: Chrome takes screen that the content needed

problems.label: Wrong culprit
problems.what: The reader blames the wrong party: the page for the browser, the site for the platform

problems.label: Buried content
problems.what: What the reader came for is pushed down or out of view

problems.label: Overload
problems.what: Too much at once, so nothing is chosen for the reader

problems.label: Builder chrome
problems.what: Things for the author, an agent or the build, shown to readers

problems.label: Missing signal
problems.what: The reader lacks what they need to decide: length, format, who wrote it, whether it is real

problems.label: Missing way in
problems.what: A page or path the reader needs does not exist

problems.label: Dead end
problems.what: Something that looks like a way in goes nowhere

problems.label: Unshareable view
problems.what: A view the reader can see but cannot link to

problems.label: Unlabelled
problems.what: A number, value or control with no label

problems.label: Alarming wording
problems.what: Words that read as a threat, a debt or a trick when they describe something benign

problems.label: Silent change
problems.what: State changes without telling the reader

problems.label: Preselected input
problems.what: An answer is chosen before the reader chooses

problems.label: Unconsented state
problems.what: Something is kept or added because the reader opened something

problems.label: Missing channel
problems.what: No way for the reader to reach a person

problems.label: Inconsistent facts
problems.what: Two places disagree about the same fact

problems.label: Stale claim
problems.what: A statement about the present that is no longer true

problems.label: Hidden until script
problems.what: Content appears only after scripts or prior state

problems.label: Host trap
problems.what: The platform behaves unlike a normal page, and the difference is not visible

problems.label: Data loss
problems.what: Something the reader made or kept is lost or cut

problems.label: Layout overflow
problems.what: Content wider or taller than the screen it is on

problems.label: Untested path
problems.what: A path shown to readers that nobody has seen work

visibility.label: Obvious
visibility.what: Every reader sees it, every time they reach that point

visibility.label: Intermittent
visibility.what: Some readers, some of the time: depends on a gesture, a device or a state, and is hard to reproduce on demand

visibility.label: Subtle
visibility.what: Felt more than seen: it costs attention or trust, but is not noticed as a bug

visibility.label: Silent
visibility.what: No symptom on screen: found only by measuring, or by its consequences

recommendations.label: Keep the UI still
recommendations.what: Nothing moves, appears or takes focus unless the reader asked for it; chrome that hides stays hidden until a deliberate gesture

recommendations.label: Cut to the essential
recommendations.what: Remove or move down everything that is not the lead, the doors and the next step

recommendations.label: Write for a stranger
recommendations.what: Rewrite the words for someone arriving for the first time

recommendations.label: Show it up front
recommendations.what: Put the signal the reader decides by (length, author, short version, real numbers) where they look first

recommendations.label: Say what it is
recommendations.what: Label it, in the reader's terms, at the moment it matters

recommendations.label: Start empty
recommendations.what: Inputs start unselected; record only what the reader did

recommendations.label: Ask first
recommendations.what: Make keeping, adding or following a tap the reader makes

recommendations.label: Make it a link
recommendations.what: Give the view, filter or label an address, and make it go there

recommendations.label: Build the way in
recommendations.what: Create the missing page or path: tag pages, series, start here, a branded 404

recommendations.label: Open a channel
recommendations.what: Send it to a person by default, with consent, and give the reader a receipt

recommendations.label: Generate from one source
recommendations.what: Publish once and generate every copy, count and label from one manifest

recommendations.label: Check it at build
recommendations.what: Make the release fail when it happens again

recommendations.label: Move it to the workshop
recommendations.what: Take builder things off reader pages, one link away

recommendations.label: Render on the first load
recommendations.what: Show the content in the HTML, with no scripts and no prior visit needed

recommendations.label: Date the claim
recommendations.what: Generate or date every statement about now, and mark fixes with their version

recommendations.label: Design for the host
recommendations.what: Use the host's own mechanisms (route variable, sg.state, vault snapshot) instead of the browser's defaults

recommendations.label: Test where readers are
recommendations.what: Run it on the device, browser and host readers actually use before showing it
